Exercise: Two-Arm Kettlebell Jerk

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- push

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- quadriceps
- triceps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
aerobic and anaerobic

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- improving_explosive_power
- enhancing_coordination_and_balance
- developing_upper_body_strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Recent shoulder surgery

Exercise Variations:

- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Jerk, equipment: kettlebells
- name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Clean and Press, equipment: kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Jerk, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you swing the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward. Squat down a few inches and reverse the motion rapidly driving both kettlebells overhead. Immediately after the initial push, squat down again and get under the kettlebells. Once the kettlebells are locked out, stand upright to complete the exercise.
